messages.subject: ggplots2
parts: Hi, i collected data from an experiment, where participants completed the task in one condition only, either A+C, or B+C. They were tested for their reaction time, movement time, path length time and normalised jerk. I need to analyse the data using ggplots in R. I am overwhelmingly stressed. Please help me with this by giving me explicit instructions and telling me what codes to use. Much appreciated.

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: Re: ggplots2
parts:
I appreciate that you're stressed, but (1) you don't typically analyze
data with ggplot2; (2) very often these "I have this general situation,
please tell me what to do" requests don't work out very well in the end,
because (a) it's hard to invest the requisite amount of time helping
random strangers on the internet; (b) it takes a long time (and a lot of
frustration) to elicit a sufficiently precise description of what it is
you want to do. In general, in these situations there *should* be
someone at your workplace who can help you ... if you can come up with a
sufficiently clear and precise description of your problem, you *might*
be able to get help at http://stats.stackexchange.com ...
